left_base.role: the sealed dual-store anchor, review loop on; the base every B4 cell extends and its PRIMARY comparator after the 2026-09-17 re-decision of module M0. Sealed bytes, never re-flown or re-scored.

left_direct_secondary.role: the released TRAIN A direct anchor; SECONDARY comparator, reported for the system-versus-direct column only. Sealed bytes, never re-flown or re-scored.

authority.own_null: analysis/SAEA-SLURP-B0-REPLICATE-PAIRED-ANALYSIS-V1/README.md; the TRAIN A own null of this geometry, h_SLU 1.1218 pp and h_intent 1.0051 pp at CI95

claim_boundary: Descriptive paired read on historically exposed TRAIN Fold A discovery rows. No superiority, generalization, component-causal or confirmatory claim; nothing about Fold B, DEV-1000 or the test split.

decision_rule.agreement_scorer: Projection v3 (slurp-slu-official-projected-v3-train) is the agreement reading: owner decision 7 of 2026-09-17 makes it the fixed post-processing of every official number, and it must agree in sign with the unprojected primary. The symmetric-normalised scorer slurp-slu-f1-normalized-v1 cannot serve on this roster -- it resolves gold from the SLURP 'devel' split and refuses TRAIN sample ids, exactly as cell B0r recorded -- so the v1 package's 'symmetric-normalised scorer agrees in sign' clause is replaced by the v3 agreement clause and this fact is recorded rather than silently dropped.

null_margins_pp.source: TRAIN A own null measured by cell B0r (docs/results/2026-09-17-slurp-b0-review-off-redecision-v2.md and analysis/SAEA-SLURP-B0-REPLICATE-PAIRED-ANALYSIS-V1/README.md); these replace the imported DEV-1000 margins 0.92 / 1.18 the v1 package used.

resampling.sensitivity: paired scenario-stratified row bootstrap, same draws and seed

decision_rule.scenario_band: A scenario loses intent beyond the null band when the CI95 upper bound of that scenario's own paired intent delta is below zero. The v1 package left this band undefined; this operational definition is fixed here, before contact, so the clause is testable. Scenario and action ROSTER-level margins remain diagnostics for the per-scenario table, as cell B0 registered them, not gates.

verdict.ADMITTED: the CI95 lower bound of the intent delta against the sealed anchor is greater than 0, pooled official SLU micro F1 is non-inferior within 1.1218 pp (its TRAIN A own-null half-width), the projection-v3 reading agrees in sign, and no scenario loses intent beyond the null band.
verdict.HARMFUL: the CI95 lower bound of the intent delta is at or below -1.0051 pp, or of the pooled SLU delta at or below -1.1218 pp, or a scenario loses intent beyond the null band.
verdict.NEUTRAL: no gate is breached but the CI95 lower bound of the intent delta is not above 0. The module enters the default plan only if it lowers cost; it does not here, so NEUTRAL means not adopted.

delta_convention: delta = cell B4A minus the sealed dual-store anchor, in percentage points; negative is worse
diagnostics_required: general scenario intent accuracy against the A3 baseline of 36.7 %
candidate coverage with and without the appended fallback (A3 baseline 86.8 %; general scenario 43 %)
the number of rows on which the fallback was appended, and the share of those on which general_quirky was then delivered
the gold general_quirky -> qa_* confusion count against the A3 baseline of 11, and the reverse direction, which was zero
the per-row slot-card supply delta the appended fallback caused (candidate_ids_without_fallback, candidate_sources), the named covariate

estimators.not_used: analysis.score_compare_cli as the runner: it hard-codes ci_level 0.90 and DEV population names

metrics.counts: tp = [slu_f1_word_tp, slu_f1_char_tp], fp and fn likewise

metrics.estimand: per-row mean of joint scenario+action correctness

roster_metadata.carries: sample_id -> scenario, speaker, headset, utterance_id; no text, transcript or gold filler
roster_metadata.speaker_key: spk:<usrid> from the governed SLURP release metadata

resampling.seed_advance: paired_contrast advances the seed by the metric index; pooled metrics use the base seed
resampling.sensitivity: paired scenario-stratified row bootstrap, same draws and seed, each scenario resampled to its own size

scorer.projection_v3_companion: slurp-slu-official-projected-v3-train, run over a COPY of the arm's sealed outputs, reported beside every official number (owner decision 7 of 2026-09-17); the anchor's v3 reading is SLU 51.99 / intent 79.35 / scenario 85.46 / action 80.65 / span 40.30
scorer.runs: once per complete manifest through core.scoring_batch, never sharded; this read invokes no scorer for the primary numbers
scorer.symmetric_normalised_companion_unavailab: slurp-slu-f1-normalized-v1 resolves gold from the SLURP 'devel' split and refuses TRAIN sample ids; no TRAIN sibling is registered, so projection v3 is the agreement reading on this roster

tables_required: headline: sealed anchor, arm, delta, speaker CI95, speaker CI90, scenario-stratified CI90, equal-scenario delta, and the released direct anchor as a secondary column
the same headline table under projection v3, beside the unprojected one
saves / harms / ties with the exact two-sided McNemar p for every per-row metric
per-scenario table, all 18 scenarios, natural mixture and equal weighting

cost table: contacts, contacts per row, repeated speech seconds, FIT endpoints, native task-contract calls, GPU hours from the serving monitor, mean latency, duty cycle, prompt-token delta against the anchor
